annotations.title: Property Snapshot by Address (365-day past storm leads plus county forecast label)

description: ONE PROPERTY, PAST 365 DAYS. Property Snapshot by Address: Past Storm Leads plus County Forecast Label. Use for recent storms at one exact address: its own reported and radar-detected storm events within a tight radius (about 150 m), with the county's current forecast label as secondary context. Input is an address with county and state, or lat/lon. Not the full archive (use get_property_storm_history_report, Storm History by Address, which searches a wider 5-mile radius so counts will differ), not a county summary (use get_storm_history), and not forecasts (use get_risk_forecast, ML Storm Forecast by Address). For paid single-address data, call get_weather_data with dataset=address and addresses=true ($0.05 flat per address; needs an Atlas United Data API key or an x402 payment).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.
